en: When water boils into steam, it expands to occupy roughly 1,600 times more space than it did as a liquid.
At room temperature, exactly 36 grams of table salt can dissolve in 100 milliliters of water before the solution becomes saturated.
When iron rusts, the chemical reaction with oxygen causes the resulting solid rust to take up about three times the original volume.
A solid block of pure gold has 19.3 times the mass of an exact same-sized block of pure liquid water.
Tungsten has the highest melting point of all metals, requiring a scorching 3,422 degrees Celsius to change from solid to liquid.
Earth's air is a gas mixture containing exactly 78 percent nitrogen and 21 percent oxygen by volume.
On the Mohs hardness scale, a diamond ranks at the maximum level of 10, while soft talc ranks at 1.
A single drop of liquid water contains over 1.5 sextillion individual water molecules.
Over 99 percent of the visible universe is made of plasma, making it the most common state of matter.
Silver conducts electricity better than any other element, outperforming copper by about 5 percent.
Ocean water is a mixture where every 1,000 grams of water contains about 35 grams of dissolved salts.
Unlike most liquids, water expands by about 9 percent in volume when it freezes into solid ice.
